The '''Belthu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belthu]].
